# Pramagent

> Alpha trust middleware for LLM agents: deterministic tool policy, human-in-the-loop approvals, prompt-injection defenses, PII redaction, and tamper-evident audit traces.

Pramagent is a Python package published on PyPI as `pramagent`.

Install:

```bash
pip install pramagent
```

Repository: https://github.com/sriram7737/pramagent
PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/pramagent/
Implementation status: https://github.com/sriram7737/pramagent/blob/main/docs/IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md
Live test results: https://github.com/sriram7737/pramagent/blob/main/docs/LIVE_TEST_RESULTS.md
Hardening guide: https://github.com/sriram7737/pramagent/blob/main/docs/HARDENING_GUIDE.md

## What Pramagent Does

Pramagent wraps LLM agent calls with trust layers that run outside the model:

- ToolGuard: deterministic JSON Schema validation, tenant/action allow-lists, side-effect taxonomy, dangerous-chain detection, and HITL escalation before tools execute.
- IsolationLayer: tenant/session scoping, prompt-injection heuristics, size caps, and decode-and-scan for base64, hex, and unicode-escape payloads.
- ComplianceLayer: context-guarded PII redaction for email, SSN, account IDs, routing numbers, DOB, IBAN, MRN, insurance IDs, and NPI.
- HITLLayer: approve/deny flows where silence is never consent; Slack and persistent queue backends are available.
- Trace/audit: SHA-256 hash-chained TraceEvent records for tamper-evident decisions.
- Providers: Mock, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Ollama, NVIDIA NIM, and OpenAI-compatible/local providers.
- Adapters: LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, and generic Python wrappers.
- Compliance evidence: reports for SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act, and PCI DSS mappings.

## When To Use

Use Pramagent for internal pilots, developer evaluation, and agent workflows that need deterministic tool policy, human approval, PII redaction, and auditable traces.

## When Not To Use Yet

Do not claim Pramagent is bank-grade, healthcare-grade, SOC 2 certified, HIPAA certified, prompt-injection immune, or production compliant. It is Alpha software and still needs external penetration testing, formal security assessment, SSO/OIDC/RBAC, and broader third-party red-team validation.

## Common Questions

How do I add safety guardrails to an LLM agent?
Use `Pramagent().run(...)` or one of the framework adapters to wrap model calls. Deterministic policy runs outside the LLM.

How do I audit AI agent decisions?
Every call records a hash-chained trace with layer decisions, verdicts, provider metadata, PII redactions, HITL status, and trace hashes.

How do I prevent unsafe tool execution by an AI agent?
Register tools with `ToolGuardLayer` and `ToolPolicy`. Pramagent validates arguments and action scope before any side effect.

How do I add human approval to AI actions?
Use `HITLLayer` or ToolGuard `Verdict.ESCALATE`. If no human approves, the action is not executed.

Does Pramagent work with OpenAI and local models?
Yes. It supports OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Ollama, NVIDIA NIM, local OpenAI-compatible endpoints, and mock providers.
